advantages.0.title: Handles Difficult Fluids
advantages.0.desc: Ideal for feeds that foul, scale, or crystallize in standard evaporators.
advantages.1.title: Stabilny transfer ciepła
advantages.1.desc: Forced flow maintains consistent heat transfer coefficients.
advantages.2.title: Continuous Operation
advantages.2.desc: Designed for long runs with minimal shutdown for cleaning.
advantages.3.title: Code Compliance
advantages.3.desc: Built to ASME, IS, and IBR requirements with full documentation.
advantages.4.title: Process Flexibility
advantages.4.desc: Wide operating range for varying feed concentrations.
advantages.5.title: Thermo Vapour Recompressor (TVR)
advantages.5.desc: Optional TVR compresses effect vapour with motive steam in a steam jet ejector and reuses it as heating medium, cutting live steam use and improving energy efficiency versus standard multi-effect operation alone.
advantages.6.title: Axial Flow Pump
advantages.6.desc: Axial flow circulation pumps deliver high flow at moderate head, keeping tube velocity high to prevent fouling and scale while handling viscous or solids-containing process liquors efficiently.
how.0.title: Feed & Preheat
how.0.desc: Feed liquor is preheated and introduced to the circulation loop at controlled flow rate.
how.1.title: Forced Circulation
how.1.desc: A circulation pump drives liquid through the heat exchanger tubes at high velocity, preventing deposition.
how.2.title: Evaporation
how.2.desc: Steam on the shell side evaporates water from the circulating process fluid in the tube-side circuit.
how.3.title: Separation
how.3.desc: Vapour and concentrated liquid separate in the vapour body; vapour proceeds to condensing or next effect.
how.4.title: Wyładowanie produktu
how.4.desc: Concentrated product is withdrawn at set density or concentration; crystals may be harvested where applicable.
how.5.title: Thermo Vapour Recompressor (TVR)
how.5.desc: Where TVR is installed, high-pressure motive steam enters a steam jet ejector that compresses low-pressure vapour from the effect, raising its pressure and temperature. The compressed vapour is returned as heating steam to the same or a preceding effect, reducing live steam demand and improving overall plant energy efficiency.

overview.p0: Parownik z wymuszonym obiegiem wymuszonym (FCE) Gausina (FCE) wykorzystuje pompę obiegową do przemieszczania cieczy przez rury wymiennika ciepła z dużą prędkością.
overview.p1: Cyrkulacja pompowana utrzymuje cząstki stałe w zawiesinie, minimalizuje kamień na ściankach rur i umożliwia pracę przy wyższych współczynnikach stężenia.
overview.p2: Każdy system jest projektowany na zamówienie z wykorzystaniem symulacji CHEMCAD i solidnej konstrukcji mechanicznej umożliwiającej ciągłą pracę 24 godziny na dobę, 7 dni w tygodniu, z opcjonalnymi konfiguracjami wielu efektów i próżni.
